picks.title: Colourful sunrise likely today 7:12am
picks.body: 70% odds of colour. Best bets: Abiqua Falls, Buxton Trestle (Banks–Vernonia State Trail), Cottonwood Canyon State Park (International Dark Sky Park). Horizon toward the sun is 83% open.
why: 82% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 83% open (25–300 km)
picks.lens: 16-50 wide, foreground first; bracket for the bright horizon
